subject: Preflight: GTM contingencies & support scenarios for Oct launch
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Preflight: GTM contingencies & support scenarios for Oct launch

Team —

Quick preflight checkpoint ahead of the public beta roll on Nov 3. I pulled a short agenda and flagged a few contingency scenarios we need alignment on before the QBR readout next week. Please skim and reply with owners or blockers.

Agenda (attached: preflight_agenda_v1.pdf):
- GTM readiness: final enablement deck + playbooks (owner: Marissa)
- Pricing & packaging cut: confirm tiering and promotional discount/window (owner: Laura)
- Support + incident playbook: triage, escalation paths, priority SLAs (owner: Marissa / Neha)
- Docs & developer quickstarts: critical gaps to close (owner: Stephanie)
- Governance & rollout policy: canary %, rollback triggers (owner: Karthik)
- External comms & partner handoff (owner: Sean)

Contingency scenarios I want us to cover in the meeting:
1) High error-rate in first 2 hours (rate-limited fallbacks / model variant failover)
2) Billing spike from churned caching behavior (throttle & temporary quota)
3) Marketplace listing delay (soft launch plan)

Please reply with: 1) your confirmation of owner, 2) one short risk you see, 3) whether you have materials ready for the QBR snapshot.

Thanks —
Sean

Thanks — I'm tracking Governance & rollout policy. Recommendation: start with a 10% canary, monitor latency/error rate and quota consumption for first 90 minutes, then move to 50% if metrics are stable. Rollback trigger: persistent token error rate >0.8% over 5 minutes or median 95th pct latency >1.8x baseline.

Open governance item: do we allow temporary model substitution (smaller quantized variant) for capacity spikes? That has privacy/data retention implications — requires an explicit mention in the customer notice. If we decide yes, legal needs to vet the wording; product should prepare fallback model config.

I will file SUP-4823 with eng to track the substitution capability and link it to the rollout playbook.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
VP, Product Operations
